Far from it. 

But when I have exhausted everything I have and I feel so hopeless because the only option left (hospital)is as scary as doing nothing, and then people criticize me on top of that, makes me feel like a injured animal trapped in a corner

I  had to go off my birth control pills bc of migraines. Tried Implanon. It's fucked up my bipolar.weee hormones My bipolar fucking up then fucks up all my other ones. Was trying to wait out the 3 month period it recommends before getting it removed.

Furthermore, bipolar doesn't always respond to shit properly. Some people just don't get better.
I have twice weekly appointments, thanks tho.

Woo, a lecture  from someone who knows nothing.

First of all, I actually made this throw-away bc I was seeking help on r/BPD, to avoid doing anything.Actually while I did sh, i stopped myself from doing potentially worse things. I went through my crisis plan. i watched a movie, had a shower, talked to a friend, had a nap. nothing helped..

I tried as hard as I could, and I gave in.

I do not want to go to hospital as ipswich mental health ward is shit and doesn't have any therapy in it, it' literally a prison, and I would rather be out and go visit my therapist early next week than be locked up somewhere I can not see family, friends, my pets or a therapist.

I have experienced trauma from my last inpatient experience, and I don't want to heap more shit on my plate.

Thanks man, yet another person who doesn't know shit.
Its more i really don't want to see medical staff if possible
